entries.1bc766a236e6b3e6: This is the group's core business, manufacturing and selling wellness care-related products (such as adult incontinence care products), feminine care-related products (sanitary products) and baby care-related products (disposable diapers for babies). Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥774,428 million (down 6.3% year on year). As of December 31, 2025, 45 companies were listed under this business segment, with the main companies including the company itself, Unicharm Products Co., Ltd., Unicharm Kokko Nonwoven Co., Ltd., Cosmotec Co., Ltd., Jiaolian Co., Ltd., Uni.Charm (Thailand) Co., Ltd. and PT UNI-CHARM INDONESIA Tbk. Management's analysis describes the background to the decline in overseas sales as follows: in China, sales temporarily fell due to reputational damage from media reports on the quality and waste management of sanitary products; in India, sales temporarily stagnated because distributors adjusted their inventories following a revision of the GST (Goods and Services Tax) system.
entries.1f4438d3ef99348a: UNICHARM CORPORATION is expanding in India and other countries with low penetration of disposable diapers, using pants-type disposable diapers as its own strength. In pet care in China, it states that it will combine the manufacturing technology and production management know-how cultivated in Japan with the production system, R&D capabilities and e-commerce sales capabilities of its partner Jiangsu Jijia Chongwu Yongpin Co., Ltd.

entries.2950eee2d0864d4b: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥945,268 million, a decrease of 4.4% from ¥988,981 million in the previous year. Personal Care was ¥774,428 million (a decrease of 6.3% year on year). The company states that in China, sales temporarily declined due to reputational damage linked to media reports on the quality and waste management of feminine care products, and that in India, sales temporarily stagnated due to inventory adjustments by distributors following the revision of the GST (Goods and Services Tax) system in September 2025. Pet Care was ¥156,084 million (an increase of 5.0%), with strong sales in North America of wet-type sub-meals for cats incorporating Japanese technology. Other was ¥14,755 million (an increase of 3.9%). The company does not undertake made-to-order production.

entries.311509a7123025f0: The products handled are divided into 3 [[term:segment|reportable segments]]. Personal Care consists of Wellness Care related products such as adult excretion care products, Feminine Care related products such as sanitary napkins, and Baby Care related products such as disposable diapers for babies. Pet Care consists of pet food related products such as food and treats for dogs and cats, and pet toiletry related products such as litter products for pets and absorbent wear. Other consists of industrial materials-related products that utilize the processing and molding technologies for nonwoven fabrics and absorbent materials. Pants-type disposable diapers are products that UNICHARM CORPORATION describes as its own strength.

entries.a8404c4e564fa1ee: UNICHARM CORPORATION forms a group comprising the company, 50 subsidiaries and 8 affiliated companies. The consolidated subsidiary Unicharm Products Co., Ltd. (Shikokuchuo City, Ehime Prefecture; ownership of voting rights 100.0%) sells products to group companies. Overseas, the consolidated subsidiaries in personal care include Uni.Charm (Thailand) Co., Ltd. (100.0%), PT UNI-CHARM INDONESIA Tbk (59.2%), Unicharm India Private Ltd. (100.0%) and Youni Jia Shenghuo Yongpin (China) Co., Ltd. (75.0%, indirect ownership), and the consolidated subsidiary in pet care is The Hartz Mountain Corporation (51.0%) in the United States (as of December 31, 2025). Among the equity-method affiliates is Jiangsu Jijia Chongwu Yongpin Co., Ltd. (45.3%, indirect ownership) in China, with which it has entered a capital and business alliance in pet care.
entries.a96183371197acad: This business manufactures and sells pet food-related products and pet toiletry-related products, among others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥156,084 million (up 5.0% year on year). As of December 31, 2025, 18 companies were listed under this business segment, with the main companies including the company itself, Unicharm Products Co., Ltd., Unicharm Kokko Nonwoven Co., Ltd., Cosmotec Co., Ltd., Peparetto Co., Ltd. and The Hartz Mountain Corporation. In North America, sales of wet-type cat side food incorporating Japanese technology performed well, achieving high revenue growth. In China, in November 2022 it entered into a capital and business alliance with Jiangsu Jijia Chongwu Yongpin Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate, and has begun manufacturing pet food.

entries.b2c91f3cb9105b68: Under its 13th medium-term management plan starting in 2026, UNICHARM CORPORATION targets consolidated revenue of ¥1.5 trillion in fiscal 2030. The core of its medium- to long-term strategy is its 3 Rs: "Renaissance (higher value added)," which raises unit selling prices through AI and digital utilization and personalized proposals; "Rebirth (moving away from manufacturing)," which shifts to a flexible revenue structure by using external partners (OEM/ODM), centered on the Global South; and "Resonance," which strengthens execution through a company-wide data platform and optimization of business processes.
